name: Is a bathtub-to-shower conversion better than reglazing the tub?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to convert the bathtub to a shower or just reglaze the tub?
mainEntity.text: Is it better to convert the bathtub to a shower or just reglaze the tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reglazing and conversion solve different problems. Reglazing makes an existing tub look newer, usually at a lower cost, and works well if the tub is still useful and the home should keep a bathtub. A tub-to-shower conversion is the better choice when the tub is rarely used, the goal is easier access, or the room needs a more modern and functional layout. Reglazing does not change the bathing experience or improve entry, while a shower conversion can transform how the bathroom is used every day. Homeowners should choose based on function, not only appearance. If the issue is cosmetic wear, reglazing may be enough. If the issue is comfort, safety, or space, conversion is usually the stronger investment. The decision should also consider resale, family needs, and whether another tub exists elsewhere in the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reglazing is best when the tub is structurally sound and the homeowner still wants a bathtub. Conversion is better when the tub is unused, hard to enter, or when a shower would improve access, space, or daily convenience.
